scope: Launcher actions, not a claim that every payload supports every firmware. Empty firmware lists mean release-specific compatibility must be checked. Existing binary versions and checksums are preserved.

actions.label: Relapse
requirements: Open on a retail PS5 or testkit running an exact listed firmware; devkits use the separate upstream devkit build.
This navigation starts the external host on the device where it is opened. Use the console browser to run its exploit chain.
9.05, 10.60 and 11.40 are not in this host's firmware whitelist. Its integrated payload menu operates after a successful jailbreak.
actions.license: No license was declared in the reviewed repository README; external launch link only. No runtime is bundled here.

actions.label: UMTX2
requirements: Open in the PS5 browser on an exact supported firmware.
The official host provides a payload menu and automatic loader. This browser chain supports only its listed versions through 5.50.

actions.label: Payload Manager
requirements: Requires an already jailbroken compatible PS5 and a running ELF loader.

Run through the local sender requires the loader to accept network connections on TCP 9021. Some autoloaders deliberately bind their loader to console loopback only; use the installed manager in that case.
Open manager works after the manager ELF is running. Its HTTP API is restricted to its own origin; a public website cannot directly launch files through that API.
To use this site's native download feed, add https://whatwhatboy.com/console/ps5/payloads.json in the manager's source settings.

Direct Run uses the documented HTTP URL interface of elfldr v0.27 on port 9021 to fetch the mirror from the actual hosting origin. The HTTP200 response is sent before downloading/spawning; it does not confirm success. Requires files hosted at a console-reachable public or computer LAN URL. Desktop localhost previews must use the paired sender; HTTPS pages can open the explicit loader link. The local sender instead sends verified local ELF bytes.
actions.license: No license was declared in the reviewed v0.6.3 README; retain the upstream release terms and attribution.

actions.label: File Explorer / websrv
requirements: Requires a compatible, already running network ELF loader on TCP 9021.

actions.label: Lua game loader
requirements: Requires a supported Artemis game and its matching CUSA/build, plus a prepared account-matched save installed using the upstream setup. Start the game to open the userland loader.
The native sender uses TCP9026 with an unsigned 64-bit little-endian byte length followed by Lua code. This is not raw ELF/BIN or a browser launch endpoint.
No packaged upstream release or ready encrypted save was found. This button opens installation instructions; it does not download or run a prepared loader.

Userland entry does not establish kernel-payload compatibility. Reviewed Lapse supports PS4 5.00–12.02 and PS5 through10.01; UMTX targets PS5 through7.61. These reviewed payloads do not establish PS4 13.52 kernel support.
